title: OKR Sprint — Gatekeeper Comms Wireframe (Q3 prep)
body:
Purpose:
This is a working wireframe for the company-wide OKR sprint comms that we will use to gate executive time and the all-team rehearsal. The goal: reduce last-minute slide churn, make the executive update crisp, and ensure follow-through on decisions. Treat as a living doc — add notes, cross-outs, and timestamps when you iterate.

Audience:
- Execs (CEO, CTO, Head of Product, Head of Eng) — primary decision forum
- All-team / All-hands attendees — context and key asks
- Managers / ICs who will operationalize next steps

High-level schedule (Q3 planning week):
- T-minus 21 days: OKR intake window opens (product-ops + leads collect proposals)
- T-minus 14 days: Gatekeeper review 1 (alignment check & ask pruning) — 60m sync
- T-minus 7 days: Draft exec update deck due (slides + 1-paragraph ask per owner)
- T-minus 3 days: Executive dry-run (45m) — exec feedback documented as action items
- D-day: All-hands (30m exec update + 15m AMA + 15m breakout prompts)
- D+3 days: Decision ledger posted, owners assigned, measurement plans due

Gatekeeper role (what to enforce):
- Trim asks: each slide must contain exactly one decision/ask and 1 metric that will change if the ask is approved.
- Clarity sprint: no vague roadmaps; deliverables must have owners and timelines (quarter and month-level).
- Risk filter: call out blocking risks and mitigation options on the same slide.
- Size cap: exec update deck max 12 slides (not counting appendix).

Comms lanes (who says what, when):
- Email (T-minus 14): high-level schedule + template link to all managers. Owner: Priya
- Slack (#company): rehearsal invite and pinned grooming checklist (T-minus 7). Owner: Marcus
- Confluence: canonical OKR intake form + consolidated asks (continuous). Owner: Aisha
- All-hands calendar invite: includes run-of-show and AMA submission link (T-minus 3). Owner: Tomás

Run-of-show (All-hands grooming):
- 0:00–0:02 — Welcome & framing (CEO): why this quarter matters, 2 lines
- 0:02–0:12 — Company priorities and asks (CTO / Head Product) — 3 slides, each 2–3 minutes
- 0:12–0:20 — Dedicated product/ops commits (released/blocked metrics, decisions requested)
- 0:20–0:30 — Customer & reliability check (SRE highlight: 1 risk + mitigation)
- 0:30–0:45 — AMA (live + pre-submitted) moderated by Head of Comms
- 0:45–1:00 — Breakouts / team sync prompts (managers lead)

Rehearsal checklist (for slide owners):
- Slide has single ask + success metric stated in numeric terms (baseline -> target).
- One-sentence why (customer impact / cost / risk).
- Owner and initial timeline present.
- Backup slide in appendix with supporting data (max 1).
- Confirmed speaker and 3 rehearsal timestamps tried (record one rehearsal).

Decision ledger format (post all-hands):
- Decision ID, short title, owner, vote (Y/N/Abstain), actions, metric to track, due date, status
- Example: DEC-001 | Pin dedicated capacity scaling policy | Owner: Head Eng | Y | Action: update SLA page by 2025-07-15 | Metric: reduction in 99th percentile latency by 10%

Escalation and fallback rules:
- If execs need more context, owner must submit a 1-pager to the gatekeeper within 48h.
- If a slide is >1 decision, gatekeeper will return to owner with mandatory redlines.
- If capacity constraints mean we must shrink the all-hands live segment to 20 minutes, then priority is: customer-impact asks > platform improvements > general updates.

Measurement and follow-up:
- Owners must declare a primary metric and an on-track cadence by D+3.
- Product-ops will surface a weekly 2-line digest for execs with progress highlights and blockers.
- At the 6-week mark, owners provide a short 1-slide status update for the next all-hands cycle.

Known risks & mitigations (working list):
- Risk: Overload of asks from multiple teams the week of gating. Mitigation: intake cap — each manager submits top 2 asks; others deferred to backlog.
- Risk: Exec time slipping. Mitigation: strict dry-run schedule and pre-submitted slides locked 72h before all-hands.
- Risk: Measurement not defined. Mitigation: template enforces baseline + target + data source.

Q&A prompts to seed AMA (collect by T-minus 3):
- How will the Dedicated capacity pricing change impact product roadmaps?
- What are the top reliability investments this quarter and trade-offs?
- How do we measure quality regressions after model quantization rollouts?

Action items (initial):
- Priya: publish intake template + sample slide by 2025-01-14.
- Marcus: schedule gatekeeper review 1 calendar and invite leads by 2025-01-15.
- Aisha: collate intake submissions and flag duplicates by 2025-01-20.
- Tomás: set up rehearsal recording channel and checklist in Slack by 2025-01-22.

Change log:
- v0.1 (2025-01-12) — initial wireframe, draft gatekeeper rules and schedule.
- v0.2 (2025-01-20) — added run-of-show and decision ledger format (Aisha).
- v0.3 (2025-02-01) — tightened rehearsal checklist and added escalation rules (Priya).

Notes to reviewers:
- This is intentionally prescriptive — we should trade some flexibility for predictability during planning week.
- Pull examples from the last two all-hands decks; annotate slides that had ambiguous asks and use them as before/after templates.
- If you see wording that will trip legal / compliance, flag immediately and we will schedule a focused 20-minute review.

Quick links (placeholders to be replaced with final URLs):
- OKR intake form: <replace-with-form-url>
- Slide template: <replace-with-drive-template>
- Decision ledger template: <replace-with-confluence-page>

End of wireframe.

(Notes left intentionally rough — drop comments inline; this doc will be the canonical gatekeeper checklist until v1 is finalized.)
